## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `prod` | `string` | **yes** | Product id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `product` | `string` | The product id. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The entitlements. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `plan_entitlement`. One of `plan_entitlement`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The entitlement id. |
| `data.product` | `string` | The product id. |
| `data.feature` | `string` | The feature key. |
| `data.feature_name` | `string` | The feature name. Present in list reads. |
| `data.type` | `string` | The feature type. Present in list reads. One of `switch`, `quota`, `meter`. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The feature unit. Present in list reads. |
| `data.value` | `string` | The granted value: `true` or `false` for a switch, an integer or `unlimited` otherwise. |
| `data.reset` | `object` | When the allowance resets, or the credits link. Null = the next invoice's usage window. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the entitlement was set. Present in list reads. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | List of plan_entitlement (feature key, name, type, unit, granted value) |
| `404` | No such product |
